subject: Request: listing discount exception for GreenWave Analytics (AWS co-sell)
messages:
From: Sara Tully <sara@greenwave.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: listing discount exception for GreenWave Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Hi Olga / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — product looked great. We're working to finalize procurement before the end of our fiscal quarter and GreenWave has a hard requirement to buy through AWS Marketplace. Our procurement team has asked whether Redwood can publish a temporary listing discount to match the direct commercial quote we received (20% off list, 12-month term).

Key details:
- Expected first-year committed spend: $180,000
- Customer type: Series B energy analytics startup (VC-backed)
- Need: private offer or discounted listing to align with internal approvals

Attached is our procurement deck and the quote from the CFO (GreenWave_Procurement_Deck.pdf). Is there a path to make the marketplace offer match the direct price (or issue marketplace credits) so we can close on AWS this quarter? We are in active co-sell with the AWS rep and would like to register the opportunity once the listing is agreed.

Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Sara
Sara Tully
Head of Partnerships, GreenWave Analytics
+1 415 555 0192

--
Attachment: GreenWave_Procurement_Deck.pdf (application/pdf, 1.8MB)
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-rep@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: listing discount exception for GreenWave Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Team,

Forwarding GreenWave's ask — they need a marketplace-compatible pricing path to close by 8/31. Quick summary: $180k ARR first year, requesting 20% off list for 12 months or equivalent marketplace credits. AWS is on the thread (cc-ed) and is motivated to register the opportunity under co-sell.

Can finance/deal desk approve a temporary listing concession or allow us to issue a private offer with matching economics? If neither is possible, what's the recommended marketplace-friendly alternative (credits, promotional SKUs, or limited-time coupon)?

Proposed mutual action:
- Redwood to publish a private offer or 12-month listing discount by 8/12
- GreenWave to sign PO and co-sell registration within 3 business days of private offer
- AWS to submit co-sell registration and assist with procurement

Please see attached procurement deck from GreenWave. Ben — assigning you to draft a pricing proposal and calc. Laura — can you give direction on acceptable concession thresholds for marketplace listings?

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 312 555 0134
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-rep@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 14:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: listing discount exception for GreenWave Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Agree this is time-sensitive. I ran the numbers and a straight listing discount of 20% would drop our first-year recognized revenue to ~144k, which is heavier than our standard co-sell concession bands for this segment. Alternate options that keep us within unit economics: 

Option A (preferred): Private Offer matching the 20% effective price but backstop via limited-term marketplace credits (e.g., $30k of promotional credits applied as a one-time ledger credit) so list price stays nearer standard and reporting remains clean.

Option B: 15% listing discount for 12 months + co-sell success milestone (additional $10k credit if they achieve a usage threshold in 90 days).

I can draft the pricing_calc.xlsx with the exact P&L and gross margin impacts. Asking finance to confirm whether Option A can be approved as an exception given the co-sell upside and AWS involvement.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: pricing_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet, stub)
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: aws-marketplace-rep@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: listing discount exception for GreenWave Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Olga / Ben,

I reviewed the numbers. Given the ARR and the co-sell registration potential, I approve a limited exception with constraints:

- Final concession: 15% listing discount for 12 months + $30k marketplace promotional credits applied at contract execution (Option B hybrid).
- Credits are one-time, non-recurring, and contingent on co-sell registration within 5 business days of private offer issuance.
- Offer to be bound to Deal ID GW-2027-0421 and expires 30 days after issuance.

Please coordinate with AWS rep to publish a Private Offer (DocuSign link below) and confirm finance sign-off on the credit ledger treatment. Use HubSpot deal link to log the concession. Legal will prep a limited addendum if needed.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0177

Hi Sara — good news. Redwood can do a limited marketplace-friendly concession to close this quarter. Summary of approved terms below and next steps.

Approved terms (Redwood + AWS co-sell):
- 15% listing discount applied for 12 months from activation
- $30,000 one-time marketplace promotional credits applied at contract execution
- Offer bound to Deal ID GW-2027-0421; expires 30 days after issuance

Next steps:
1) AWS to publish a Private Offer linked to GreenWave (aws-marketplace-rep cc-ed) and send DocuSign private-offer URL.
2) GreenWave to sign PO / private offer within 3 business days of issuance.
3) Redwood finance will apply credits at execution; Laura will confirm ledger treatment and confirm by email.

Attaching the private offer stub (private-offer-PO.pdf). I can also schedule a short triage call if you want to walk procurement through the sign process.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — excited to close and get GreenWave onboarded.

Best,
